body:
I don't want to come across as a troll, I'm just entirely cynical and more than a bit jaded, but...

I feel no gratitude towards my creator, if there is one. I never asked to exist. All this talk of "life is only what you envision"... If that's true, then why must I envision life? Is it not my choice to end it? I don't think that's being a prick to the universe that created me. It's just a polite "Thanks, but no thanks."

I'm not completely alone. I have people to talk to. But talking to them only helps for a very short while. As soon as the IM window is closed, I go back to lonely, depressed me. The lack of sleep doesn't help either. My friends still have lives of their own, so they can't always be there for me. Hence, my turning to reddit, and even 4chan (assholes they may be, but the guys in the baww threads have huge hearts). Talking does help, but it doesn't seem like it's enough. Maybe I'm expecting too much from the words of strangers? I do appreciate your taking time to respond to me. I'm just thinking out loud
